title: 1st Grade Math Quiz
description: Ten questions for 1st graders: adding and subtracting within 20, comparing numbers and simple word problems, with step-by-step explanations.

questions.question: Which number is greater: 13 or 31?
questions.explanation: 31 has 3 tens and 13 has only 1 ten, so 31 is greater even though both use the digits 1 and 3.

questions.question: What is 5 + 6 + 4?
questions.explanation: Add left to right: 5 + 6 = 11, then 11 + 4 = 15. (Adding 6 + 4 = 10 first also works!)

questions.question: Sara has 12 stickers. She gets 5 more. How many stickers does she have now?
questions.explanation: 12 + 5 = 17. If you got 7, you subtracted instead of adding.

questions.question: What is 20 − 7?
questions.explanation: 20 − 10 = 10, so 20 − 7 is 3 more than 10, which is 13.

questions.question: What number is 10 more than 45?
questions.explanation: 10 more means the tens digit grows by 1: 45 becomes 55.

questions.question: Tom had 9 marbles. He lost 4 of them. How many does he have left?
questions.explanation: 9 − 4 = 5. Lost means take away, so subtract.

questions.question: Which sentence is true?
questions.explanation: 14 is bigger than 9, so 14 > 9 is true. The > sign always opens toward the bigger number.
